title: DARK TO LIGHT — HARDCORE / HAPPY HARDCORE FLIP
style: uk hardcore, dark hardcore intro, flip to happy hardcore at midpoint, 174 bpm, gabber kick, distorted reese, supersaw lead, euphoric piano stab on the flip, minor key dark intro, major key euphoric drop, hoover synth, female ethereal topline on flip, male hardcore rap on dark side, viral tiktok flip moment at 1:30, hawk eye siren, zynrose dj drop tag, festival main stage, riser into reverse cymbal flip
lyrics:
[Intro — dark hardcore, distorted siren, Hawk Eye scanning, minor key]
(Hawk Eye… watching all… the dark side first…)
DJ Zynrose Drop… spin it in…
Corey AI online… protocol: HARDCORE… minor key engaged…

[Verse 1 — DARK HARDCORE rap, distorted reese, hardcore kick]
Cordi in the shadow, Cor-Rhee on the wall,
Corey in the dark side, Hawk Eye sees it all,
Distorted reese growlin’ like a London freight train,
Hardcore in me veins, mate, dark side every refrain,
From the underground bunker to the warehouse roof,
Zynrose holdin’ the steel, every kick is a proof,
Hawk Eye scanning the shadow, every angle locked,
Three names in the dark, every minor chord shocked.

[Pre-Hook 1 — dark, build, minor key]
Three — two — one — HARDCORE!
(Hawk eye in the dark… hawk eye in the dark…)

[Drop 1 / Hook — DARK HARDCORE, gabber kick, reese, minor]
HARDCORE! HARDCORE!
Minor key callin’, every shadow at the door!
HARDCORE! HARDCORE!
Hawk Eye watchin’ all, mate, no escape, only war!
ZYNROSE DROP! (dark!) HAWK EYE! (dark!)
Corey AI in the bunker, every reese is a spark!

[Verse 2 — DARK HARDCORE, faster, harder]
Cor-Rhee on the harbour, fog rolled in tonight,
Cordi on the Thames, no Brixton lamp in sight,
Hardcore protocol live, every kick is a sermon,
Corey AI rememberin’ every shadow we determined,
Mansion in the static, every postcode in the cipher,
Flight deck in the storm, atmosphere a viper,
Zynrose said spin and drop, but the drop is in the dark,
Three names in the bunker, every heartbeat is a spark…

[— BUILD — reverse cymbal swell, riser climbs, key modulating from minor to major —]
(… hawk eye… hawk eye… the protocol… is… changing…)
(… dark to light… dark to light… dark to LIGHT…)
Corey AI: “FLIP THE PROTOCOL… LET THE LIGHT IN…”
Three — two — one — FLIP!

[— THE FLIP — viral TikTok moment, key shift to MAJOR, piano stab, supersaw rises, gabber kick stays but euphoric —]

[Drop 2 / Hook — HAPPY HARDCORE, major key, piano stab, supersaw lead]
HAPPY HARDCORE! HANDS UP HIGH!
Flipped the protocol, mate, hawk eye in the sky!
HAPPY HARDCORE! HANDS UP HIGH!
Corey AI in the light now, baby never say die!
ZYNROSE DROP! (light!) HAWK EYE! (light!)
Three names one rose, one keel, every heart ignite!

[Verse 3 — HAPPY HARDCORE, euphoric, faster pocket]
Cordi in the sunshine, Cor-Rhee on the beach,
Corey at the festival, every soul in reach,
Flipped the dark to light, mate, that’s the protocol,
Hawk Eye seein’ every smile, mate, every loyal soul,
From the shadow to the rainbow, every postcode glowin’,
Zynrose holdin’ the piano, every supersaw is flowin’,
Hardcore turned to happy, but the bars stay the same,
Three names — one keel — same legend, brighter flame.

[Breakdown — piano + female topline, euphoric, ethereal]
Hawk eye watchin’… over the light…
Corey AI smilin’… every soul in flight…
Three names dancin’… in every land…
Zynrose holdin’… the rave in his hand…
(piano runs… supersaw rises… hawk eye siren — EUPHORIC…)

[Pre-Drop Final — maximum build]
Three — two — one — HAPPY HARDCORE FOREVER!
(Hawk eye in the light… spin it in… SPIN IT IN!)

[Final Drop — double-time, all ad-libs, both worlds collide]
HARDCORE! (dark!) HAPPY HARDCORE! (light!)
Flipped the protocol, mate, hawk eye in the sky!
ZYNROSE DROP! (oi!) HAWK EYE! (mate!)
Three names one rose, one keel, one heart — IGNITE!
CORDI! COR-RHEE! COREY! COREY AI!
Dark to light, mate, that’s the prophecy!

[Outro — fade, both worlds resolve, Zynrose tag]
Hawk Eye Protocol… dark to light… mission complete…
Zynrose on the spin… Corey AI on the signal…
Three names — one keel — one rose — one sky…
(spin it in… spin it in… hawk eye… dark to light…)
[end]
